result.summary: Requires an ICU-capable, ventilator-equipped bed based on acute respiratory failure with endotracheal intubation and invasive ventilation documented October 9–10; no subsequent extubation is documented. Current concerns include decompensated cirrhosis with ascites/SBP, acute kidney injury, persistent electrolyte abnormalities, severe coagulopathy and thrombocytopenia, and altered mental status supporting fall precautions. Central venous access is supported; DNR status and palliative-care involvement are documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No organism or explicit precaution supporting contact isolation; MRSA screen is negative, and nonspecific yeast in urine/sputum does not establish a contact-isolation indication.
